question_vi: Lazy loading là gì? Cách implement trong React?
question_en: What is lazy loading? How do you implement it in React?
answer_vi: Lazy loading trì hoãn tải resource đến khi thực sự cần — giảm initial load time và Time to Interactive. - **Ảnh** — `` native: browser tự tải khi scroll gần đến; không dùng cho LCP image. - **Component React** — `const HeavyChart = React.lazy(() => import('./HeavyChart'))` + `}>`; chunk được split tự động và load on demand. Dùng cho component nặng: chart library, editor, PDF viewer. - **Next.js** — `dynamic(() => import('./Map'), { ssr: false })` cho component chỉ chạy được trên browser. - **Route-based** — mỗi route một chunk với React Router + `React.lazy()`; đây là pattern chuẩn. - **Preload trước khi cần** — gọi `import('./HeavyPage')` trong `onMouseEnter` để giảm perceived latency khi user sắp navigate. - **Intersection Observer** — API detect element vào viewport để trigger lazy load; nền tảng của nhiều lazy-loading library. Đánh đổi: lazy loading tạo waterfall (request phải chờ parent component render xong) — cẩn thận với critical path, chỉ lazy-load phần thật sự non-critical
answer_en: Lazy loading defers loading a resource until it is actually needed — reducing initial load time and Time to Interactive. - **Images** — native ``: the browser loads the image as the user scrolls near it; never use it on the LCP image. - **React components** — `const HeavyChart = React.lazy(() => import('./HeavyChart'))` + `}>`; the chunk is split automatically and loaded on demand. Use for heavy components: chart libraries, editors, PDF viewers. - **Next.js** — `dynamic(() => import('./Map'), { ssr: false })` for browser-only components. - **Route-based** — each route as its own chunk with React Router + `React.lazy()`; the standard pattern. - **Preload ahead of need** — call `import('./HeavyPage')` in `onMouseEnter` to cut perceived latency before the user navigates. - **Intersection Observer** — API that detects when an element enters the viewport to trigger lazy loading; the basis of many lazy-loading libraries. Trade-off: lazy loading adds a waterfall (the request waits for the parent component to render) — be careful on the critical path; only lazy-load truly non-critical parts
answer_html_vi:
Lazy loading trì hoãn tải resource đến khi thực sự cần — giảm initial load time và Time to Interactive.

  • Ảnh — <img loading='lazy'> native: browser tự tải khi scroll gần đến; không dùng cho LCP image.
  • Component React — const HeavyChart = React.lazy(() => import('./HeavyChart')) + <Suspense fallback={<Spinner/>}>; chunk được split tự động và load on demand. Dùng cho component nặng: chart library, editor, PDF viewer.
  • Next.js — dynamic(() => import('./Map'), { ssr: false }) cho component chỉ chạy được trên browser.
  • Route-based — mỗi route một chunk với React Router + React.lazy(); đây là pattern chuẩn.
  • Preload trước khi cần — gọi import('./HeavyPage') trong onMouseEnter để giảm perceived latency khi user sắp navigate.
  • Intersection Observer — API detect element vào viewport để trigger lazy load; nền tảng của nhiều lazy-loading library.

Đánh đổi: lazy loading tạo waterfall (request phải chờ parent component render xong) — cẩn thận với critical path, chỉ lazy-load phần thật sự non-critical.
answer_html_en:
Lazy loading defers loading a resource until it is actually needed — reducing initial load time and Time to Interactive.

  • Images — native <img loading='lazy'>: the browser loads the image as the user scrolls near it; never use it on the LCP image.
  • React components — const HeavyChart = React.lazy(() => import('./HeavyChart')) + <Suspense fallback={<Spinner/>}>; the chunk is split automatically and loaded on demand. Use for heavy components: chart libraries, editors, PDF viewers.
  • Next.js — dynamic(() => import('./Map'), { ssr: false }) for browser-only components.
  • Route-based — each route as its own chunk with React Router + React.lazy(); the standard pattern.
  • Preload ahead of need — call import('./HeavyPage') in onMouseEnter to cut perceived latency before the user navigates.
  • Intersection Observer — API that detects when an element enters the viewport to trigger lazy loading; the basis of many lazy-loading libraries.

Trade-off: lazy loading adds a waterfall (the request waits for the parent component to render) — be careful on the critical path; only lazy-load truly non-critical parts.
